idb.name: idb_base | RTH | a2.5 | eod
idb.entry: Prior day was an INSIDE day (prev_inside_day==1). After the opening range forms (minute>=10:00 ET; OR=09:30-10:00 high/low), LONG when a 5m CLOSE breaks above or_high (and prior close<=or_high); SHORT when close<or_low. Fill next bar open.
idb.signal: long: prev_inside_day==1 & minute>=600 & close>or_high & close.shift(1)<=or_high; short: mirror with or_low.
idb.stop: 2.5 x ATR at the signal bar (ATR = base Wilder ATR). STOP slipped 1 tick.
idb.target: NONE — hold to end of day (no fixed target).
idb.exit: EOD_FLAT at 15:55 ET, or the 2.5xATR stop, whichever first. No trailing / time stop.
idb.rr_type: DYNAMIC (no fixed target; realized R measured)

swd.name: swd_clean_path | RTH | a2.5 | toPOC
swd.entry: LONG: swept a confirmed swing LOW (swept_low==1) AND a displacement candle up (displacement==1 & close>open); FILTER: entry is below prior POC by >0.5 ATR (vp_d_poc_atr<-0.5) AND no opposing prior HVN within 1 ATR above the path (vp_dist_hvn_up_atr is null OR >1.0). SHORT: mirror. Fill next bar open.
swd.signal: long: swept_low==1 & displacement==1 & close>open & vp_d_poc_atr<-0.5 & (vp_dist_hvn_up_atr null or >1.0); short: mirror.
swd.confirmation: displacement candle in trade direction + clean path to POC (no blocking HVN)
swd.stop: 2.5 x ATR at the signal bar. STOP slipped 1 tick.
swd.target: Prior-session POC (vp_prior_poc), distance clamped to [0.5, 8] x ATR; if POC is not in the trade direction, fallback target = 2 x stop. TARGET = exact limit.
swd.exit: POC target limit, or 2.5xATR stop, or EOD_FLAT 15:55, whichever first.
swd.rr_type: DYNAMIC (target = POC distance; realized R measured)

port.name: portfolio = idb_base + swd_clean_path (1 MNQ each)
port.entry: Run both strategies concurrently, 1 MNQ each, independently.
port.signal: union of idb and swd signals
port.exit: each leg per its own rule; both flat by 15:55
